FINAL("WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         substr(y.Date, 1, 4) AS yr,
         SUM(y.Consumption) AS cons
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN cons END), 0) AS cons_2012,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN cons END), 0) AS cons_2013
  FROM yearly
  GROUP BY Segment
),
calc AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         ((cons_2013 - cons_2012) / NULLIF(cons_2013, 0.0)) * 100.0 AS pct
  FROM pivot
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT Segment, 1 AS ord
  FROM (SELECT Segment FROM calc ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Segment, 2 AS ord
  FROM (SELECT Segment FROM calc ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1)
)
SELECT Segment
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ord;")
